summary: Internet Identity login tracking hook/component was added and mounted globally, and backend gained a recordInternetIdentityLogin method plus storage for login metadata. However, the backend method shown does not reject anonymous callers, and the required admin-only query endpoint for listing records is not evidenced in the provided backend diff snippet. Additionally, multiple unrelated frontend/UI changes appear in the diff summary, which were not requested and conflict with the “additive and localized” constraint.

missing_requirements.requirement: Reject calls to the Internet Identity login tracking method when the caller is anonymous, with a clear authentication-required trap/error.
missing_requirements.reason: The added backend method recordInternetIdentityLogin() records for whatever caller it receives, but the shown implementation contains no guard/trap for anonymous principals (no Principal.isAnonymous check and no trap).

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an admin-only backend query endpoint that returns the list of Internet Identity login records, enforced via existing admin authorization (e.g., AccessControl.isAdmin) and traps with Unauthorized for non-admins.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend code references a useListInternetIdentityLogins hook and AdminUsersPage calls it, but the backend diff snippet only shows recordInternetIdentityLogin and does not show any new admin-only query method or its authorization enforcement. With truncated backend content, there is insufficient evidence this endpoint was implemented.

hallucinated_features.description: Multiple unrelated UI/UX and styling changes across various pages/components (LandingPage gradient/divider changes, AccessPlansPage/ProductPage card dividers, header navigation replaced with hamburger menu, footer content changes, global CSS utilities, tailwind config changes, document title change).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly constrained changes to be additive and localized to Internet Identity login tracking and the owner-only listing; these broader site redesign/styling/navigation changes were not requested.
